aiConnections.localLogin.hostedUnavailab.en: Server-host subscription sign-in is unavailable on this hosted instance. Choose a supported sign-in environment or use an API key.

aiConnections.localLogin.windowsUnavaila.en: Server-host subscription sign-in is unavailable on Windows because Paperclip cannot safely read isolated credential files on this platform. Choose a supported sign-in environment or use an API key.
aiConnections.localLogin.windowsUnavaila.zh-CN: Windows 暂不支持服务器端订阅登录，因为 Paperclip CN 无法在此平台上安全读取隔离的凭据文件。请使用支持的登录环境，或通过 API 密钥连接。
